description: We are ITS TEAM, an award-winning technology team from Fırat University, Türkiye. With 2nd and 3rd place achievements at GakCoding Hackathon, we specialize in AI, software engineering, full-stack development, and UI/UX design. At NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to create innovative, impactful, and scientifically grounded solutions. We welcome passionate teammates skilled in AI, data science, space technologies, and research. Join us to turn ambitious ideas into reality!
